footer.tagline:
NuunPlatform — A Somali Learning Platform for Secondary Students

NuunPlatform is a Somali educational platform designed for secondary school students. It offers interactive quizzes, live quizzes, PDF resources, student groups, and more—all in one place. Our goal is to make learning more accessible, engaging, and effective for every student..
